tasks.analysis: Honeybee social structure is a fascinating example of cooperation and division of labor in the animal kingdom. The main role of the queen bee is to lay thousands of eggs to keep the colony growing. Worker bees are the busy multitaskers; they collect nectar and pollen, feed baby bees, clean the hive, and stand guard against intruders. The only job of the male drones is to mate with a queen from another hive. Each bee plays a unique role, and this organized system of cooperation helps the colony survive and thrive. 蜜蜂的社会结构是动物界合作与分工的绝佳范例。蜂后的主要职责是产下数千枚卵，维持蜂群繁衍。工蜂是忙碌的多面手，它们采集花蜜和花粉、喂养幼蜂、清理蜂巢并抵御入侵者。雄蜂唯一的任务是与其他蜂巢的蜂后交配。每只蜜蜂都各司其职，这种有序的协作体系让蜂群得以生存和兴旺。
